statistics.unit: one campaign = one independently generated seed corpus (30,000 base identities); base identities are NOT treated as independent
statistics.statistic: number k of campaigns with Recall_ONE_MF > Recall_TF0 at primary margin 0.5 (VALIDATION, GlobalSourceRecall)
statistics.p_value: two-sided exact binomial: min(1, 2*min(P[Bin(10,0.5) >= k], P[Bin(10,0.5) <= k]))
statistics.decision: met iff 10 valid campaigns, protocol frozen, k = 10 positives (p = 2/1024 = 0.001953125 <= 0.0026998); k = 9 gives p = 0.0215 and does NOT meet 3 sigma
secondary_descriptive: mean, SD, SE and t(9) 95% CI of the per-campaign recall gain
per-campaign identity-clustered paired CI (assumes identity independence, not validated)
historical Hoeffding alpha 0.025 per campaign, reported unchanged
delta FP, observed FDR and conditional CP upper, fragmentation, fusion, conflicts, fanout P99, P95
statistics.independence_assumption: campaigns differ only by generator seed and run on separate runners with separate disposable SQL; assumed independent replications of the synthetic generator, not of real data
statistics.not_claimed: 3 sigma concerns the direction of the gain in the synthetic population; not FDR certification, not '99.73% of links correct', not V8 superiority, not operational authorization

closure.stop_rule: all 10 campaigns run once; no early stopping, no extra campaigns to reach significance, no seed replacement after any result is known
closure.failure_rule: a TECHNICAL failure (no transfer-results.json produced) is retried with the same seed and LOCK, cause documented; any campaign that produced transfer-results.json is final, whatever its result
closure.code_change_rule: if the executor must change, record the new SHA and show snapshot SHA-256, plan hashes and generator digest unchanged
closure.invalid_campaign: a campaign that cannot pass the LOCK/provenance gates is not a statistical result; if it cannot be made valid the primary criterion is NOT met
